build.title: Orchestrator: start a build through the API, MCP and CLI

said.text: Add a start/launch command to the build orchestrator, exposed through control@1 so it appears in the REST API, the MCP server and the CLI (planner.builds act 'start' or a build-orchestrator/start command). It takes a build id that must already exist in the orchestrator (build ID verified as usual), and the orchestrator picks the model per step. It must respect the owner-only 'Launch builds without asking' setting: when that's off, the start is a held axHub call Brett approves or vetoes; when it's on, it runs at once. Also fix planner.builds status so the three build states (pending, queued, building) are accepted, since 'queued' is currently rejected as an unknown status. Brett: "Yeah, you might as well build that shit because you know there's gonna be a next time."

steps.text: Add a start command to the build orchestrator, exposed via control@1 (API, MCP, CLI); verify the build ID; orchestrator picks models
Respect 'Launch builds without asking': held axHub call when off, runs at once when on; accept queued/building as statuses; tests + plugin lifecycle check
